In the repo, dlt copies the Source NOT NULL onto Warehouse columns, so after accepting a dropped column (orders.customer_id) the next load fails with NotNullViolation. Accept must also make the dropped columns nullable in the Warehouse table; the goal (break, halt, accept, pass) is unchanged. User chose this option (AskUserQuestion, 2026-11-18).
